roleTitle: Registered Nurse (RN) - Staff Development & Infection Control
description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as a Registered Nurse specializing in Staff Development and Infection Control. This vital role combines your expertise in nursing education with critical infection prevention strategies, ensuring the highest standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs, fostering continuous professional growth, and leading all infection control initiatives. Your work will directly contribute to maintaining regulatory compliance and promoting best practices across the facility.We offer a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting. If you are a passionate RN with a commitment to quality education and patient safety, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland.
Proven experience in staff development, education, or training within a healthcare setting.
Demonstrated knowledge and experience in infection prevention and control practices.
Familiarity with state and federal healthcare regulations (e.g., CMS, CDC guidelines).
Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently purchased facility, playing a pivotal role in shaping its future success and driving census growth.

The ideal candidate is a highly presentable and proactive individual with a proven track record in healthcare marketing. You will be instrumental in developing and executing strategies to attract new residents and build strong community relationships. This role requires flexibility, including working occasional weekends, and offers excellent compensation for the right person who can deliver exceptional results.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or senior living environment
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and achieve marketing objectives
Professional demeanor and excellent communication skills
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
A proactive and results-oriented approach to marketing and community outreach
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and proven track record.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a leading health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN (as needed) opportunity offers excellent flexibility, allowing you to balance your professional commitments with your personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

In this role, you will provide high-quality physical therapy services to patients, helping them regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized treatment plans, ensuring comprehensive and effective care. This position offers a competitive hourly rate for your expertise.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred
Ability to work on a PRN/per diem basis
Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for Physical Therapists is $39.00 - $40.00 per hour.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a leading skilled nursing facility in Ocala, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team focused on providing high-quality rehabilitative care to patients, helping them regain independence and improve their quality of life.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate, providing a stable and rewarding career path. You will work alongside a supportive team of therapy professionals, utilizing your skills to implement individualized treatment plans and make a significant impact on patient recovery.If you are a motivated PTA looking for a full-time role in a dynamic healthcare environment, we encourage you to apply. Join a facility committed to clinical excellence and patient-centered care.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work full-time hours
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join the team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment.As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, assisting patients in regaining independence in daily living activities. Your expertise will be crucial in implementing individualized treatment plans, monitoring patient progress, and ensuring a high standard of care. Join a facility committed to providing exceptional rehabilitation services and making a positive impact on the lives of its residents.
requirements: Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) certification
Current state licensure in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work full-time
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for COTA/PTA is $28.00 - $37.00/hr. Compensation for PT/OT/ST is $40.00 - $49.00/hr.
